title: 第一卷 第8章 误会
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
这时候。

    刚刚三岁的侄子李天佑看到他，张开手跑过来，往他身上扑：“小叔，小叔，我要抓螃蟹，你带我去抓吧。”

    “求你了。”

    李华把他抱起来，说道：“涨潮了，抓不了。”

    “叔改天带你去抓。”

    李天佑不高兴，噘着嘴说道：“我就要今天，就要今天。”

    薛凤骂道：“闹什么闹，再闹等你爸回来，看打不打你。”

    “阿华，把天佑放下。”

    “让他去一边玩去。”

    李天佑不敢再闹腾。

    大哥李文是家里的顶梁柱，也是权威，别说李天佑，他这个当弟弟的也怕。

    李华将装着青蟹的红色塑料袋递过去：“看看里面是什么。”

    李天佑打开塑料袋，低头一看，惊讶的喊道：“哇，是青蟹！”

    “一，二，三，三只呢。”

    “小叔，是给我的吗？”

    李华笑着问道：“给你的，够不够吃？”

    李天佑猛点头，说道：“够了，够了，我吃一个就好。”

    “妈妈说不能多吃。”

    李华把他放下，小家伙瘦得很，抱在手上都没什么分量。

    他们一家六口人，就靠着大哥李华的工资过活，还有就是老娘和嫂子做做渔网，赶海抓些海鲜补贴家用。

    家里面的日子过得紧巴巴的，海鲜倒是能管够，可这玩意在摄入不了足够油水的情况下，不能多食。

    吃多了，越吃越饿，人就会瘦得不成样子。

    老娘和大嫂一脸惊诧，齐声问道：“青蟹哪来的？”

    李华说道：“我去滩涂地抓的。”

    “你看看，这一身泥。”

    老娘还是不信，说道：“你说实话。”

    李华无奈：“真是实话。”

    “我还挖了很多蛏子，个头都很大，去码头卖给了白沙村的张海洋，不信你找人问问。”

    老娘和嫂子对视一眼。

    这是太阳打西边出来了？

    滩涂地赶海可不轻松，光是在里面走路就够累的，还挖到蛏子抓到青蟹，这是走了狗屎运？

    薛凤回过神来，把青蟹从李天佑的手里抢过去，递给李华，说道：“好几十块钱一斤呢，这些个头都不小，能卖不少钱，你拿去卖掉。”

    李华说道：“这是我专门抓给天佑和阿娟吃的。”

    “他们喜欢吃。”
content_en:
This time.

    When his nephew Li Tianyou, who had just turned three years old, saw him, he ran over with open hands and pounced on him: "Uncle, uncle, I want to catch crabs. Please take me to catch them."

    "Please."

    Li Hua picked him up and said, "The tide is high and we can't catch him."

    "Uncle will take you to catch him another day."

    Li Tianyou was unhappy and pouted and said, "I want today, I want today."

    Xue Feng scolded: "Why are you making trouble? If you make trouble again, wait until your father comes back and see if he will beat you."

    "Ahua, put Tianyou down."

    "Let him go and play."

    Li Tianyou didn't dare to make any more noise.

    The eldest brother Li Wen is the backbone and authority of the family. Not to mention Li Tianyou, even his younger brother is afraid of him.

    Li Hua handed over the red plastic bag containing blue crabs: "Look what's inside."

    Li Tianyou opened the plastic bag, looked down, and shouted in surprise: "Wow, it's blue crabs!"

    "One, two, three, three."

    "Uncle, is it for me?"

    Li Hua smiled and asked, "Is this enough for you?"

    Li Tianyou nodded fiercely and said, "That's enough, that's enough. I'll just eat one."

    "Mom said you can't eat too much."

    Li Hua put him down. The little guy was so thin that he didn't weigh much in his hands.

    Their family of six lives on the salary of the eldest brother Li Hua, while my mother and sister-in-law make fishing nets and catch some seafood from the sea to supplement the family income.

    Life at home is tight, and seafood can be enough, but if you can't take in enough oil and water, you can't eat too much.

    If you eat too much and the more you eat, the hungrier you will become, the more you will lose weight.

    My mother and sister-in-law looked surprised and asked in unison: "Where did the blue crabs come from?"

    Li Hua said: "I went to the tidal flat to catch it."

    "Look at this mud."

    The old lady still didn’t believe it and said, “Tell the truth.”

    Li Hua was helpless: "It's really true."

    "I also dug up a lot of razor clams. They were all very big. I went to the dock and sold them to Zhang Haiyang from Baisha Village. If you don't believe me, ask someone."

    My mother and sister-in-law looked at each other.

    Is this the sun coming out in the west?

    It's not easy to catch the sea on the tidal flat. Just walking in it is tiring enough, and you also dug up razor clams and caught blue crabs. Is this really bad luck?

    Xue Feng came to his senses, snatched the green crab from Li Tianyou's hand, handed it to Li Hua, and said: "It costs dozens of yuan per catty. These are not small and can be sold for a lot of money. You can sell them."

    Li Hua said: "I caught this specially for Tianyou and Ajuan to eat."

    "They love to eat."
